prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: full-bleed cartoon birthday invitation background with live text added separately.
Primary request: add a delicate little ribbon frame around the perimeter of this supplied flat cartoon card. Use a slim, flat muted rose ribbon, approximately 0.7 percent of the canvas width, following an inset of about 2.5 percent from the outer edges. Gently rounded corners and a tiny burgundy ribbon bow at the upper-left corner, no larger than 5 percent of the canvas width. A few simple fold marks make it read as a ribbon, with restrained cartoon outlines matching the cake. It should look airy and understated, never a large billowing decorative ribbon. Where the ribbon would cross the cake or cake stand, it passes BEHIND those objects and is hidden. The perimeter frame must not cover any part of the cake.
Constraints: preserve every existing element exactly: flat cream background, blush tabletop, oval shadow, cartoon cake details, cake position/scale/crop, three lit candles, cherries, small cake bows and pedestal. Keep the left and upper center completely clear for live text. Retain original aspect ratio. Add only the slim ribbon perimeter and its tiny upper-left bow; no confetti, extra objects or lettering. No texture, watercolor, gradients, 3D or watermark. Output only the finished background artwork.
Input image: edit target, square artwork.
